title: 재외공관주재무관의 대외직명에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1

Article 3 (External Official Titles of Military Attachés)
(1) The Minister of Foreign Affairs may designate external official titles for military attachés (including assistant attachés) stationed at diplomatic missions abroad pursuant to the Decree on the Stationing of Military Attachés at Diplomatic Missions Abroad, in accordance with general international practices or international agreements. <Amended on Sep. 20, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013>
(2) The criteria for designating external official titles under paragraph (1) shall be as prescribed in the attached Table. <Amended on Aug. 14, 2006>
